heuristics.ALT: max(scaled, d(L,t)-d(L,n), d(n,L)-d(t,L)) using finite pairs

metadata.landmark_selection: Nearest distinct walkable cells to interior quarter anchors; 2 landmarks are prefix of 4
metadata.query_scope: Fixed start/end, free goal; fresh preprocessing on every measured run, no cross-query cache
metadata.time_stages: preprocessing includes terrain conversion, minimum scan, landmark selection and both distance directions; query includes heuristic evaluation and path reconstruction; total measured per sample
metadata.memory_stages: total=max(preprocessing peak, query peak with retained index); query additional=max(0, query peak - retained preprocessing allocation); Python tracemalloc, input excluded
metadata.expansion_scope: main expanded_nodes counts query only, goal and stale entries excluded; preprocessing expansions recorded separately
